body: Advisor ruling needed on #2594 (BUG-1996), finding B3. On main only epics reach the queue-advance Close path, and epics are not code-typed, so the completion-linkage warning there can never fire. To test it, the factory made --yes auto-close parents (B1) and made Stories ready-to-close (B2). A probe showed B2 closing a Done story before merge and skipping the merge auto-bump. Options: (a) keep the warning on the Close path as defence-in-depth, revert B1 and B2, and pin it with a dispatch-level unit test; or (b) approve stories as ready-to-close, with status guards, as a separate spec. Round-1 review suggested "e.g. a Story", which caused this. My recommendation is (a). Details: PR #2594 comment, and BUG-1996. #2594 is 2/3 rounds used.
subject: Ruling needed: #2594 BUG-1996 close-path scope (B3)
